Condition: 300 Hz 4th-order high-pass + the whole output −6 dB. Background = a real engine battle recording (`tools/audio/_render/recording_pb_r08_s23`: music stem at its recorded bus gain + all other SFX/UI). Each cue (manifest vol_db, own music duck) is placed at 1 s steps over that background; SNR = median over the cue's own loud 50 ms frames (within 15 dB of its peak frame) of K-weighted cue minus background, both after the phone filter. masked = SNR < 0 dB, at risk = < 3 dB. Too quiet = max momentary < -40 LUFS after filter and −6 dB (internal heuristic). Proxies only; nobody has listened on a phone.
